description: The advertised list-valued vocab_processors argument cannot pass through the vocabulary cache.
trigger: Pass any list, including [], as FormatronFilter.vocab_processors.
expected_behavior: Forward the processors to get_original_characters and construct the vocabulary.
actual_behavior: create_engine_vocabulary is decorated with lru_cache and receives the list unchanged, causing an unhashable-list TypeError before its body executes.
